title: The Orchard Swarm
logline: An orbital arborist fights to protect three generations of heirloom honeybee hives from a pharmaceutical company that holds a debt lien and plans to harvest the entire swarm for a lucrative drug patent.

roles.description: Tends thirty hectares of orbital citrus domes; scholarly, devoted, desperate to protect her living pollinators from corporate liquidation.
Station corporate representative; slick, impatient, determined to execute the patent seizure order before local fruit crops blossom.
A reinforced corporate cutter equipped with chemical fog projectors and heavy pulse weapons.
The alliance of independent station farmers cultivating fresh produce in competition with corporate synthetic pastes.
The biomedical enterprise holding patents on radiation-sickness therapies derived from insect venom compounds.
A magnificent transparent agricultural bubble filled with blooming orange and lemon trees.
A climate-controlled research module where seventy generations of certified disease-free honeybee colonies are maintained.
The central municipal concourse where agricultural commodity contracts and patent registries are filed.

public_situation: Station farmers gather at {role:orchard_dome} as {role:pharma_conglomerate} arrives with an industrial repossession team to execute a biological patent lien.
private_truth: {role:pharma_factor} plans to euthanize all thirty heirloom hives to extract a rare neuroprotective venom enzyme that was synthesized by the bees feeding on local orbital citrus blossoms.

beats.public_change: Corporate bailiffs set up inspection barriers outside {role:apiary_vault}, ordering all bee movement suspended.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to purchase specialized cryogenic sugar syrup at the exchange concourse and deliver it to the vault to induce hibernation in the queen hives.
missions.private_fact: She has kept two queen hives hidden inside her personal sleeping cabin to protect them from the corporate bailiffs.

beats.public_change: {role:hydroponic_collective} convenes an emergency assembly, warning that liquidating the pollinators will cause total citrus crop failure.

missions.reason: She needs a pilot to scan the patent registry archives and locate the founding colonial agricultural charter that gave the hives collective protected status.
missions.private_fact: Her grandfather helped draft the charter but traded away the venom extraction rights to settle an old refinery hospital bill.

beats.public_change: {role:repo_gunboat} approaches {role:orchard_dome} with industrial gas canisters to harvest the hives by force.

missions.reason: She needs the corporate gunboat disabled before its chemical cannons vent fumigation gas into the apiary filtration ducts.
missions.private_fact: The gunboat captain hails offering sixty thousand credits and a share of the venom patent royalties if the pilot surrenders the dormant queen crates.

beats.public_change: The arborist and collective representatives gather at {role:orchard_dome} as the blossom season reaches its peak.

missions.reason: She needs the dormant queen hives delivered into the central canopy release pylon so the swarm can pollinate the trees before the flowers wither.
missions.private_fact: She plans to release the bees into the general dome atmosphere where corporate bailiffs cannot recapture them without destroying the trees.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the final release controls at the canopy pylon while corporate lawyers and farm delegates debate.

options.label: Release the queen hives into the canopy to save the orchard crop
Broker a shared charter licensing venom milkings while keeping the hives alive
Hand the queens over to the pharmaceutical factor for the full bounty

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the gunboat and releases the queens.
resolutions.summary: The honeybee swarm is released into {role:orchard_dome}. The citrus trees are pollinated on schedule, preserving the heirloom harvest and defying {role:pharma_conglomerate}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot disabled a corporate gunboat and freed thousands of heirloom honeybees into an orbital orange orchard.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a compromise licensing seasonal venom extraction.
resolutions.summary: A compromise agreement is signed. The collective retains the live pollinators for dome agriculture while {role:pharma_conglomerate} licenses non-lethal seasonal venom collection.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the pharma bounty and hands over the queens.
resolutions.summary: {role:pharma_conglomerate} extracts the venom and destroys the heirloom hives. Patent profits soar, but {role:orchard_dome} produces no fruit, forcing the station onto synthetic rations.

consequences.public_summary: Miners tell of a pilot who pocketed pharma cash while the station's last natural honeybees were culled for medicine.

resolutions.reached_by: The charter search fails or the pilot abandons the contract.
resolutions.summary: Bailiffs seize {role:apiary_vault} and botch the cryogenic extraction. The heirloom honeybees suffocate, leaving {role:orchard_dome} barren and bankrupting the agricultural collective.

loose_threads.detail: The pharmaceutical patent folio contains a licensing contract signed with an anonymous offshore shell trust registered to a station magistrate.
Synthetic protein paste futures jumped forty percent the day before the repossession team arrived at the orchard dome.
The repossession gunboat transponder transmits a hull serial code formerly assigned to an agricultural inspection cutter.

radio_hooks: Agricultural concourse reports sharp spike in synthetic nutrient paste commodity contracts.
Orchard arborists warn of impending fruit crop failure if pollinator hives remain grounded.
Pharmaceutical holding corporation asserts validity of patented genetic extraction liens.

voice_direction.orchard_arborist: Measured, scholarly, and deeply attached to her work. Speaks of botanical and insect cycles with reverent affection and bristles at corporate terms.
voice_direction.pharma_factor: Crisp, businesslike, and condescending. Frames the destruction of living hives as an inevitable biological yield optimization problem.
